```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## Average bill length by species

```{r}
#| label: summary-table
penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(avg_bill_length_mm = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE))
```
